name: RCECAP
recent: RCE Capital 在截至2026年9月30日的季度录得营收8402万令吉、净利3221万令吉，净利同比增9.9%。公司宣布每股3仙的第一次中期股息，除权日为12月7日。此外，公司终止2020年员工认股计划并实施新计划，同时有多项大股东权益变动申报。
notable: 宣布每股3仙的第一次中期股息，除权日12月7日，派发日12月21日。
截至2026年9月30日季度净利同比增9.9%至3221万令吉。
终止2020年员工认股计划，并于2026年10月16日实施新员工认股计划。
risks: 多名大股东在10月至11月间多次申报权益变动。
首席执行官、副首席执行官、首席财务官等高管于11月20日接受ESOS期权。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度，营收8402万令吉，环比增7.2%，同比增1.6%；净利3221万令吉，环比增5.9%，同比增9.9%；净利率38.3%，低于上季度的38.8%。

recent_en: RCE Capital reported revenue of RM84.02 million and net profit of RM32.21 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 9.9% year-on-year. The company declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share, with ex-date on 7 December. It also terminated the 2020 Employees Share Scheme and implemented a new scheme, alongside several substantial shareholder interest change filings.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share, ex-date 7 December, payment date 21 December.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 9.9% year-on-year to RM32.21 million.
Terminated the 2020 Employees Share Scheme and implemented a new Employees Share Scheme effective 16 October 2026.
risks_en: Several substantial shareholders filed multiple changes in interest between October and November.
The CEO, Deputy CEO, CFO and other senior officers accepted ESOS options on 20 November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM84.02 million, up 7.2% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net profit was RM32.21 million, up 5.9% QoQ and 9.9% YoY; net margin was 38.3%, down from 38.8% in the previous quarter.
